source.creator: 築島裕 著
source.rights: In copyright. Only these bibliographic facts are recorded here; scans and crops are kept outside the repository.
source.note: 第二部 假名字體表: one plate per manuscript, with a gojūon grid in which each cell sets the attested written forms of one kana side by side. Part 2 (點圖集所載) plates are grouped by ヲコト點 family, part 3 (點圖集不載) by point group; "group" and "number" are the plate label as printed, e.g. (2)14. "code" is the parenthesised code printed after the plate label; it is often, though not always, the year of annotation. "annotated" is the 年代加點 field, falling back to 年代書寫 where the plate gives no annotation date. "page" names the scan page (a = vol. 1–2, b = vol. 3–4) and "book_page" the printed page. Titles, holders and dates are editorial readings of the plate headers.
